enrich.confirm:
Enrich every contact by scanning emails, WhatsApp messages, and Paperless docs?

Proposals land in the edit-contact form as pre-filled fields + dropdowns of alternatives. Nothing is changed until you save a contact. ~5-15 minutes for a couple hundred contacts on a local LLM; runs in the background, safe to close this page.
